_comment: No production traffic history exists yet for this app (personal project) — user opted for 'small-app defaults' via an explicit AskUserQuestion choice rather than exact numbers. Every number here is a stated assumption, not a measured fact; see 'assumptions' below and revisit once real traffic data exists.
assumptions: No production traffic data exists yet — this is a pre-launch personal project. Current/projected TPS, peak concurrent users, and latency targets are all reasonable defaults for a small booking app, not measured numbers. Revisit once real usage data exists.

currentTps=5, projectedTps=15 (3x headroom) modeled as weighted customer journeys/sec (70% browse-only, 20% view-bookings, 10% full seat-hold+booking-confirm), matching the app's real traffic shape rather than raw HTTP req/s.

preAllocatedVUs/maxVUs sized as target_rate * ~2.5s avg iteration duration (incl. think-time sleeps) * ~1.75 safety factor — recompute if journey sleep durations or the browse/checkout mix change materially.
auth_signup latency target (p95<900ms) accounts for this app's deliberate scrypt password hashing cost (server/lib/password.ts) — expect this to be one of the slower flows by design, not a bug.

peakConcurrentUsers=50 with a 5-minute soak hold — long enough to surface Postgres connection-pool exhaustion or slow leaks, per the skill's guidance that these rarely show up in the first 60 seconds.
